verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say v5 "catches more bugs" and "flags fewer false positives" using parallel scoped agents, and that noise control and a strictness setting limit reviews to high-signal feedback. TREX runs the PR branch in a sandbox to find runtime-only bugs. An independent user reports it "more often than not catches real issues," though it can be "a bit overzealous." missing for 10: no documented or hands-on evidence for specific bug classes such as race conditions or edge cases, no accuracy benchmarks or detection-rate data, and only a single thin piece of independent corroboration.
